page.layout: Running head at top with page number at left. Below it one block of text: a four-line italic verse stanza, then the centred word FINIS., then a woodcut ornament. No margin notes.

p.i: Hac luce tandem perpetuum decus Lustrata proles Abramidum feret: Atque hostibus victrix subactis, Læta tuas canet vsque laudes.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below FINIS. (a mask with foliage and scrolls) is an engraving and is not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page is visible in the lower half and was left out. The stanza's first line and the pair of lines beginning "Atque" and "Læta" are set with indentation, which is kept as line breaks only. The verse ends the poem that began on the previous page.
